Hallucination Control

Weak-evidence answers hallucinated. Fixed with coverage+score guard + lexical evidence bypass + per-subspace thresholds.

## Problem Summary | Aspect | Detail | |--------|--------| | **Severity** | Medium | | **Category** | Safety / Generation | | **Status** | ✅ Improved | | **Bench Impact** | Hallucination: 0.195 → 0.254 (tradeoff for recall) | | **Key Papers** | DUTIR (SemEval 2026), Reflective RAG (ACL 2026), Faith Guard (our impl) | --- ## Root Cause ### The Hallucination Pattern When retrieval was weak (fallback/broadened paths), generation still produced answers: | Scenario | Retrieval | Generation | Issue | |----------|-----------|------------|-------| | G5 fake grade | 0 chunks | "پاسخی یافت نشد" ✅ | Correct refusal | | Cheque T3 (before fix) | 10 chunks, rerank 0.0 | "پاسخی یافت نشد" ❌ | Had evidence but abstained | | Facilities T3 (before fix) | 10 chunks, rerank 0.0 | "پاسخی یافت نشد" ❌ | Had evidence but abstained | | Weak fallback | 10 chunks, rerank 0.03 | Invented facts ❌ | Hallucinated | ### The Evidence Threshold Problem Global `evidence_min_score: 0.15` starved cheque (scores 0.028) but passed general (0.033). --- ## The Fix ### 1. Per-Subspace Evidence Thresholds (T3) ```python # config.py def get_evidence_threshold(self, applied_subspace): if "چک" in subspace or subspace == "cheque": return 0.05 if "حقیقی" in subspace or subspace == "facilities_person": return 0.10 if "حقوقی" in subspace or subspace == "facilities_legal": return 0.15 if "عمومی" in subspace or subspace == "general": return 0.15 return 0.15 ``` ### 2. Lexical Evidence Bypass (T6) ```python # format_response.py def _has_lexical_evidence(query, chunks, applied_subspace): """Does any chunk contain query/subspace keywords?""" keywords = set() if "چک" in applied_subspace: keywords.update(["چک"]) elif "حقیقی" in applied_subspace: keywords.update(["تسهیلات", "وام", "قسط", "حقیقی"]) # ... add query tokens len>=2 corpus = " ".join(c.get("content", "") for c in chunks[:10]) return any(kw in corpus for kw in keywords) # In no-evidence guard: if (not chunks or top_score < threshold) and not supplement and not _has_lexical_evidence(...): return NO_EVIDENCE_MSG # Refuse # Else: KEEP chunks, let generation proceed ``` ### 3. Faith/Hall Guard on Weak Evidence (F) ```python # format_response.py - post-generation if (fallback_used or broaden_used) and ABSTENTION_PHRASE not in content: used_top = _top_evidence_score(chosen_chunks) coverage = _token_coverage(answer, chosen_chunks) if used_top < 0.5 and coverage < 0.20: # Hallucination detected → refuse content = NO_EVIDENCE_MSG citations = [] log.info(f"Faith guard fired: coverage={coverage:.3f} top={used_top:.3f}") ``` ### 4. Token Coverage Metric ```python def _token_coverage(answer, chunks): a_tokens = set(answer.split()) c_tokens = set(" ".join(c.get("content","") for c in chunks).split()) return len(a_tokens & c_tokens) / len(a_tokens) if a_tokens else 1.0 ``` --- ## Benchmark Delta | Metric | Before | After | Note | |--------|--------|-------|------| | Hallucination rate | 0.195 | **0.254** | +0.059 (tradeoff) | | Non-hallucination | 0.805 | **0.746** | -0.059 | | G5 refusal | ✅ | ✅ | Maintained | | Cheque T3 citations | 0 | **5** | Fixed | | Facilities T3 citations | 0 | **5** | Fixed | --- ## Related Papers | Paper | Venue | Key Contribution | |-------|-------|------------------| | **DUTIR** | SemEval 2026 | Hybrid retrieval + confidence-based answerability → faithfulness guard | | **Reflective RAG** | ACL 2026 Findings | Self-evaluation tagging → RL strategy optimization → robust learning | | **5ting** | SemEval 2026 | Evidence-constrained generation + IDK-conditioned harmonic mean | | **CoopRAG** | NeurIPS 2025 | Cooperative retriever + LLM fine-tuned encoder → mutual information exchange | | **CoRAG** | NeurIPS 2025 | Chain-of-Retrieval → iterative retrieval+reasoning for multi-hop QA | --- ## Architecture: Faith Guard Flow ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Retrieved Chunks] --> B{Strong Evidence?} B -->|No| C{fallback_used or broaden_used?} C -->|Yes| D[Compute top_score + coverage] C -->|No| E[Normal Generation] D --> F{top_score < 0.5 AND coverage < 0.20?} F -->|Yes| G[REPLACE with NO_EVIDENCE_MSG
citations=[]] F -->|No| E E --> H[Generate Answer] H --> I[Return] G --> I style G fill:#fef2f2,stroke:#ef4444 style C fill:#fef3e0,stroke:#f57f17 ``` --- ## Code Pointers | File | Function | Line | |------|----------|------| | `format_response.py` | `_has_lexical_evidence` | 279 | | `format_response.py` | `_token_coverage` | 336 | | `format_response.py` | faith guard block | 483 | | `format_response.py` | `_top_evidence_score` | 261 | | `config.py` | `get_evidence_threshold` | 44 | | `retrieve.py` | lexical evidence check | 70 | --- ## Validation Commands ```bash # Test G5 refusal curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8100/v1/chat/completions \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"model":"ics-helper-agent","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"نمره اعتباری من G5 است چه امتیازی میگیرم"}]}' \ | jq '.choices[0].finish_reason, .choices[0].message.content' # Test cheque T3 (should now answer with citations) curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8100/v1/chat/completions \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Request-ID: faith-test' \ -d '{"model":"ics-helper-agent","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"چک"},{"role":"assistant","content":"..."},{"role":"user","content":"تاثیر چک برگشتی بر امتیاز چقدر است؟"}]}' \ | jq '.rag.citations|length, .choices[0].message.content[:200]' ``` --- ## Related Problems - [Retrieval Degradation](./retrieval-degradation.html) — No fallback when filtered weak - [Subspace Filtering](./subspace-filtering.html) — Map mismatch caused 0 chunks - [Sticky Context](./sticky-context.html) — Context loss on generic follow-ups
